title: Audit Sprint Prep — SOC2/ISO 1:1 Notes (Noah)
content:
Context: prepping for 1:1 with security manager (Aisha) and follow-up with infra owners. Sprint window: next 6 weeks to close high-priority evidence gaps for SOC2 Type II readiness and ISO alignment. Quick notes to self and agenda items below (working doc — rough).

Meeting goals:
- Align on top 6 control gaps we can close during sprint.
- Confirm owners for each evidence artifact and expected delivery dates.
- Decide on vendor evidence ask cadence & standard template.
- Triage which items need cross-team escalation (SRE/Platform/Legal).

Agenda (30–40m):
1) Quick status (3–4m): what moved since last week (short bullets).
2) Gap triage (10–12m): review top gaps, impact level (high/med/low).
3) Evidence plan (10m): who creates evidence, where to store, verification steps.
4) Vendor asks (5m): finalize ask list and SLAs for responses.
5) Next steps & owners (5m).

Immediate red-flag gaps (notes + suggested owner):
- KMS key rotation log missing for a subset of dev GPUs (owner: Marco) — evidence: rotation schedule + Cloud KMS audit export (high).
- Third-party vendor data flow diagrams incomplete (owner: Solutions Eng) — evidence: diagram + DPIA stub (high).
- Change management entries for model rollout not linked to ticketing (owner: Release Eng) — evidence: change ticket examples, approval emails (med).
- Endpoint auth tests / proof of least privilege for internal RPCs (owner: Platform Eng) — evidence: test run outputs, policy docs (med).
- Retention policy not consistently applied for embeddings index snapshots (owner: Data Infra) — evidence: retention config, purge logs (low/med).

Vendor risk / third-party checklist (short template):
- Vendor name + primary contact
- Data types processed (PII? pseudonymized? embeddings?)
- Contractual controls (DPA, subproc list) — yes/no + date
- SOC2 / ISO certs held (attach cert)
- Evidence to request: network diagram, access controls, encryption in transit/at rest, incident history (last 24 months), subcontractors list, pen test summary
- Desired response SLA: 7 business days for standard asks, 3 business days for clarifying Qs

Notes to self about ask wording (for canned template):
- Keep requests scoped and prioritized: start with encryption, access controls, and incident history.
- Ask for screenshots + exportable logs where possible (don’t ask for raw creds).
- Provide example filenames and expected formats (PDF certs, CSV export of incidents, Cloud console export for logs).

Action items (concrete, owner, due):
- [ ] Marco: export KMS rotation audit (sample period: last 12 months) + short README explaining rotation policy. Due: 2025-01-17.
- [ ] Aisha: finalize vendor evidence template and send to top-5 vendors. Due: 2025-01-14.
- [ ] Release Eng (TBD): link 3 recent model rollout tickets to change approvals and paste in Confluence. Due: 2025-01-20.
- [ ] Platform Eng (Elena): run internal RPC auth smoke test and store outputs in shared evidence bucket. Due: 2025-01-21.
- [ ] Me (Noah): compile list of vendors with outstanding certs + escalate to Legal if >14 days no response. Due: 2025-01-16.

Follow-up items to raise in next sync:
- If vendor response rate < 60% after first ask, escalate to procurement/legal for contract leverage.
- Re-evaluate evidence storage: move verified artifacts to confluence page SEC-EVIDENCE-2025 (immutable copies + pointers to S3) — ask infra for read-only bucket.
- Decide whether to run a short tabletop for incident response for model-data incidents (1 hour) within sprint.

Open questions / risk points (need to decide quickly):
- Are embeddings considered "derived PII" in our DPA language? If yes, need to mark accordingly in vendor asks. (ask Legal)
- Do we have an agreed canonical place for video recordings of training/meetings involving customer data? (storage + retention)
- For ISO: which controls map cleanly to our current internal processes vs which require new policy drafting? (quick mapping exercise requested)

Quick tactical checklist before 1:1 (to run through during meeting):
- [ ] Bring current evidence tracker (JIRA filter: SEC-OPEN)
- [ ] Bring vendor list + previous responses (sheet)
- [ ] Bring example artifact filenames and expected formats
- [ ] Have escalation path for slow vendors ready (procurement/legal names)

Tone notes (for the convo):
- Be collaborative not accusatory — we want owners to help ship artifacts, not feel blamed.
- Prioritize high-impact gaps first (log evidence + KMS + vendor certs).
- Keep sprint short and high-velocity — small wins matter.

Scratchpad / shorthand (brain dump):
- evidence bucket: s3://redwood-sec-evidence/2025/sprint1 (confirm with infra)
- confluence page to create: SEC-EVIDENCE-2025/sprint-1 (template: summary + artifact links + verification notes)
- remind: get signed DPA scan for vendor X (waiting)
- think about: can we automate export of rotation logs weekly? (low-hang automation)

Possible blockers and mitigations:
- Vendor slow response — mitigation: prioritize vendors by data impact and escalate to vendor PMs + procurement.
- Infra time crunch — mitigation: pick sampling approach (export 2 weeks instead of full 12 months) and mark as sample + follow-up.
- Legal review latency — mitigation: draft short ask with Legal copied and request 48h turnaround for simple clauses.

Next meeting prep:
- Update this doc with any evidence received before next 1:1.
- Prepare 2–3 slides showing sprint progress (percent closed by risk tier).
- Confirm who will verify artifacts (QA step) and add to owners list.

End notes: keep this doc updated as single source of truth for my personal tracking. Move finalized artifacts to confluence + immutable S3 bucket.

-- Noah K. (quick scratchpad, not polished)
